tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It snows/snowed 的 snow 是動詞；It is/was snowy 的 snowy 是形容詞。There is/was + rain/snow 與 We/They have/had + rain/snow 都能表示某地有雨雪，但主詞與動詞不可混搭。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，不能說 many rains。There 開頭要搭配 is/was；We/They 開頭要搭配 have/had。問句分別是 Is/Was there ...? 與 Do/Did we/they have ...?，兩套句型不可混搭。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain here every spring.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 是複數，描述每年春天的一般情況要用 have。

quiz.question: There ___ much snow in this town last winter.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，last winter 是過去時間，所以用 There was。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot in Hokkaido every January.
quiz.hint: a lot 修飾下雪的動作，every January 表示習慣，因此用動詞 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ snowy and cold yesterday.
quiz.hint: snowy 是形容詞，前面要用 be 動詞；yesterday 表示過去，所以用 was。

quiz.question: They ___ only a little rain there last summer.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 搭配 have；last summer 是過去時間，因此用 had。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow on the ground now.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，now 表示現在，所以用 There is。

quiz.question: It ___ heavily in the mountains last night.
quiz.hint: heavily 是副詞，用來修飾動詞；last night 表示過去，因此用 snowed。

quiz.question: It ___ very snowy in the mountains today.
quiz.hint: snowy 是形容詞，today 表示現在，應用 It is snowy。

quiz.question: ___ there much rain in Kaohsiung in summer?
quiz.hint: there be 句型的一般現在式問句，要把 Is 放到 there 前面。

quiz.question: ___ they have a lot of snow in winter?
quiz.hint: 主詞 they 搭配動詞 have，現在式問句用 Do。

quiz.question: We ___ much rain in our city last May.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 使用 have 句型；last May 表示過去，所以改成 had。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain here every summer.
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，描述每年夏天的一般情況要用 There is。

quiz.question: It often ___ in Korea in winter.
quiz.hint: often 表示經常發生的動作，主詞 It 後用第三人稱單數 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ rainy and windy this morning.
quiz.hint: rainy 和 windy 都是形容詞；早上的情況已過去，所以用 was。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of snow in their town every year.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 是複數，every year 表示一般情況，因此用 have。

quiz.question: There ___ much snow outside yesterday morning.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，yesterday morning 是過去時間，所以用 There was。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly describes habitual snowfall?
options: A. It snow a lot here every winter.
B. It is snow a lot here every winter.
C. It snowy a lot here every winter.
D. It snows a lot here every winter.
quiz.hint: every winter 表示習慣，It 後的動詞 snow 要加 s，形成 snows。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly describes snowy weather today?
options: A. It snowy and cold today.
B. It is snowy and cold today.
C. It snows and cold today.
D. It have snowy and cold today.
quiz.hint: snowy 和 cold 是形容詞，前面要用 It is。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses We have with rain?
options: A. We have a lot of rain in spring.
B. We are a lot of rain in spring.
C. We is a lot of rain in spring.
D. We has a lot of rain in spring.
quiz.hint: 以 We 為主詞描述某地有許多雨時，用 We have + rain。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses There is with snow?
options: A. There have a little snow on the roof.
B. There are a little snow on the roof.
C. There is a little snow on the roof.
D. There has a little snow on the roof.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，there be 句型要用 There is。

quiz.question: The weather is cold, and it ___ a lot here in winter.
quiz.hint: a lot 修飾下雪的動作，in winter 表示一般情況，因此用 snows。

quiz.question: The roads were white because it ___ snowy last night.
quiz.hint: 空格後已有形容詞 snowy，且 last night 是過去時間，所以用 was。

quiz.question: It ___ a little yesterday afternoon.
quiz.hint: a little 修飾下雨的動作，yesterday afternoon 表示過去，因此用 rained。

quiz.question: It ___ cloudy, but it did not rain yesterday.
quiz.hint: cloudy 是形容詞，yesterday 表示過去，因此前面用 was。

quiz.question: We ___ much snow here now, but there ___ no snow last year.
quiz.hint: We 後用 have；snow 是不可數名詞，last year 的 there be 句型用 was。

quiz.question: There ___ much rain today, but they ___ little rain last month.
quiz.hint: today 用 There is；They 的 have 在 last month 要改成過去式 had。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of snow every winter, and it often ___.
quiz.hint: They 後用 have；often 表示習慣，It 後用 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ snowy today, but it ___ a lot yesterday.
quiz.hint: today 的形容詞 snowy 前用 is；yesterday 的下雪動作用 snowed。

quiz.question: ___ there a lot of rain here last night?
quiz.hint: there be 句型搭配不可數名詞 rain，過去式問句用 Was there ...?

quiz.question: ___ you have much snow in your hometown?
quiz.hint: 主詞 you 搭配動詞 have，現在式問句要用 Do。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather in your town in winter?
quiz.hint: How 問天氣時用 How is the weather ...?，不需要 like。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like there yesterday?
quiz.hint: What 問天氣要搭配 like；yesterday 表示過去，所以用 was。

quiz.question: What is the weather ___ in Seoul today?
quiz.hint: What is the weather like ...? 是詢問天氣的正確句型。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather at the beach last weekend?
quiz.hint: How 問天氣不用 like；last weekend 表示過去，所以用 was。

quiz.question: A: How is the weather today? B: It ___ sunny.
quiz.hint: sunny 是形容詞，回答現在的天氣要用 It is sunny。

quiz.question: A: What was the weather like yesterday? B: It ___ cloudy and wet.
quiz.hint: cloudy 和 wet 是形容詞，yesterday 表示過去，所以用 was。

quiz.question: Which sentence means 「我們這裡冬天有很多雪」?
options: A. There have a lot of snow here in winter.
B. We have a lot of snow here in winter.
C. We are a lot of snow here in winter.
D. It have a lot of snow here in winter.
quiz.hint: 以 We 為主詞表示「我們這裡有……」，要用 We have + snow。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses the there be pattern?
options: A. There had much rain yesterday.
B. There were much rain yesterday.
C. There have much rain yesterday.
D. There was much rain yesterday.
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，yesterday 表示過去，正確形式是 There was。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses snow as a past-tense verb?
options: A. It was snow a little yesterday.
B. It snowy a little yesterday.
C. It snowed a little yesterday.
D. It was snowy a little yesterday.
quiz.hint: 要表達「下了一點雪」，snow 是動詞；yesterday 要用 snowed。

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses snowy as an adjective?
options: A. It is snowy in the mountains today.
B. It snows snowy in the mountains today.
C. It have snowy in the mountains today.
D. It snowy in the mountains today.
quiz.hint: snowy 是形容詞，前面要搭配 be 動詞：It is snowy。

quiz.question: Taiwan usually ___ much rain in May.
quiz.hint: Taiwan 是第三人稱單數，usually 表示一般情況，因此 have 要變成 has。

quiz.question: We ___ a little snow in our town now.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 是複數，現在式用 have。

quiz.question: There ___ little rain in the town last month.
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，last month 表示過去，所以用 There was。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot last night, but it is not snowy now.
quiz.hint: a lot 修飾下雪的動作，last night 表示過去，因此用 snowed。

quiz.question: It is ___ today, and it may snow tonight.
quiz.hint: is 後面要接形容詞 snowy，表示天氣是下雪的。

quiz.question: When it ___, the roads turn white.
quiz.hint: 句子描述一般情況，When it 後要接動詞 snows。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of snow outside, so the children are excited.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，現在的 there be 句型用 There is。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of rain last night, so the river rose quickly.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 使用 have 句型；last night 表示過去，因此用 had。

quiz.question: Which question correctly asks about rain with have?
options: A. Are they have much rain there?
B. Is they have much rain there?
C. Does they have much rain there?
D. Do they have much rain there?
quiz.hint: 主詞 they 的現在式問句用 Do they have ...?

quiz.question: Which question correctly asks whether snow exists outside?
options: A. Does there have much snow outside?
B. Is there much snow outside?
C. Do there have much snow outside?
D. Are there much snow outside?
quiz.hint: 詢問是否有不可數名詞 snow，要用 Is there ...?
